say:0:1820417101:1.text: The two Graveborn continue discussing their plans.
say:0:1820417101:1.source_cn: 两个亡灵在屋内兴致勃勃地讨论起来。

say:1:1820417102:1.text: First, they plot how to pin the missing limb on the Repair House. Then they discuss how they'll spend all their iron.
say:1:1820417102:1.source_cn: 先是商量该如何将丢失肢体的责任全部推到修缮屋头上，再是...

say:2:1820417103:1.text: You listen from outside, fury burning in your chest. It's time for someone—or some wolf—to teach them a lesson!
say:2:1820417103:1.source_cn: 你在窗外听得怒火中烧。是时候该有一个正义的人——亦或是...
say:2:1820417103:1.male: You listen from outside, fury burning in your chest. It's time for someone—or some wolf—to teach them a lesson!
say:2:1820417103:1.female: You listen from outside, fury burning in your chest. It's time for someone—or some wolf—to teach them a lesson!
